title: Price Adjustments
description: Ordered selection-dependent fee and discount rows on a binding fixed-price option; fixed_price is the base rate. One row fires per dimension (first match in declared order); stacking is additive against the base rate, so cross-dimension order does not change the price. Changing the table requires a new pricing_option_id. Sellers MUST NOT return a table to callers below adcp_version 3.3. Normative rules: docs/media-buy/advanced-topics/pricing-models.mdx#selection-dependent-price-adjustments.

format_option_ref.description: Matches when the purchase selects it; MUST resolve to a value of the same product.

kind.description: fee adds its delta; discount subtracts it.

name.description: Name carried into the resolved price_breakdown.

rate.description: Proportion of the option's fixed_price (0.15 = 15%), never of another row. Exclusive with amount; use amount for 100% or more.

amount.description: Amount in the option's currency per pricing unit. Exclusive with rate.

placement_ref.description: Matches when the purchase selects it; MUST resolve to a value of the same product.

kind.description: fee adds its delta; discount subtracts it.

name.description: Name carried into the resolved price_breakdown.

rate.description: Proportion of the option's fixed_price (0.15 = 15%), never of another row. Exclusive with amount; use amount for 100% or more.

amount.description: Amount in the option's currency per pricing unit. Exclusive with rate.

verifier_constraints.selector_resolution: Each row's ref MUST resolve to a value the same product publishes; matching is full-identity equality.
verifier_constraints.price_precision: Greatest of the currency minor-unit exponent, 4 for cpm/vcpm/cpc/cpcv/cpv, and the fewest decimals exactly representing fixed_price and each amount, by numeric value.
verifier_constraints.resolved_price_binding: A buyer-supplied pricing that differs from the resolved result MUST be rejected with INVALID_REQUEST carrying resolved_fixed_price and resolved_price_breakdown.
